en.summary: A group defending democracy has sent a letter to Brazil's Supreme Court expressing support for measures taken by Justice Edson Fachin.

en.title: Producer of 'Dark Horse' film denies use of amendments and says she feels pressured to turn state's evidence

stories.title: Em carta, empresários, juristas e economistas manifestam apoio a Fachin e pedem reforma do Judiciário

en.title: In letter, business leaders, legal experts and economists express support for Fachin and call for judicial reform
en.summary: Over 180 business executives, lawyers, economists and former ministers signed a letter supporting the Supreme Court president and requesting institutional reforms to prevent the court's capture by private interests.

stories.title: Flávio Dino determina quebra de sigilo fiscal de produtora de 'Dark Horse'

en.title: Flávio Dino orders breaking of tax secrecy for 'Dark Horse' producer

stories.title: Análise: Ao expor suspeita sobre o PCC, Dino desafia Mendonça e vulnerabiliza Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Analysis: By exposing suspicion about the PCC, Dino challenges Mendonça and weakens Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: A Supreme Court justice's decision in an investigation regarding public resources allegedly used to finance a controversial film creates tension among justices and complicates the position of a senator.

stories.title: Investigações da PF e da Polícia Civil apuram uso de recursos públicos para financiar 'Dark Horse'

en.title: Federal Police and Civil Police Investigations Examine Use of Public Resources to Finance 'Dark Horse'
en.summary: Federal Police and Civil Police are investigating the alleged diversion of public funds to companies linked to the producer of the film Dark Horse, which chronicles former president Jair Bolsonaro's career. Disclosed documents reveal inquiries into parliamentary amendments directed to entities of the film's producer.
